Which statement best distinguishes a dimension from a quantity?

```{devoirs_choices}
#| label: choices_d01.dimension.quantity
- 'A dimension is an aspect of a system; a quantity is a measurable way of representing that aspect.':
    correct: true
- 'A quantity is an aspect of a system; a dimension is always a number.':
    correct: false
- 'Dimension and quantity mean exactly the same thing.':
    correct: false
- 'A dimension must be measured in meters.':
    correct: false
```
